# ART Runtime Inspection: GC, Heap Profiling, Lock Contention & Jank Monitoring

Inspected repository: `/home/ethen/workspace/voyah/projects/8397/code/qssi/art` (shallow commit `9a380e42`, Android 15 / V QSSI tree). All paths below are relative to `/home/ethen/workspace/voyah/projects/8397/code/qssi/art/` unless an absolute path is noted.

---

## 1. GC, Heap, Blocking Allocations & OOME Diagnostics

### 1.1 Slow GC & Long Pause Detection Thresholds and Logging
* **Default Constants** (`runtime/gc/heap.h:146-149`, `runtime/gc/heap.cc:199, 229`):
  * `kDefaultLongPauseLogThreshold = MsToNs(5)` (**5 ms**; `long_pause_log_threshold_`, `heap.h:1407`, `heap.cc:329`).
  * `kDefaultLongPauseLogThresholdGcStress = MsToNs(50)` (**50 ms**).
  * `kDefaultLongGCLogThreshold = MsToNs(100)` (**100 ms**; `long_gc_log_threshold_`, `heap.h:1410`, `heap.cc:330`).
  * `kDefaultLongGCLogThresholdGcStress = MsToNs(1000)` (**1000 ms**).
  * `kGcStressModeGcLogSampleFrequencyNs = MsToNs(10 * 1000)` (**10 s** rate-limit in `gcstress`).
  * `kLogAllGCs = false` (`heap.cc:199`).
* **Runtime Options** (`runtime/runtime_options.def:71-74, 83`, `runtime/parsed_options.cc:222-227, 238-242, 802-803`, `runtime/runtime.cc:1851-1854`):
  * `-XX:LongPauseLogThreshold=<ms>` (`Opt::LongPauseLogThreshold`, converted via `MsToNs`).
  * `-XX:LongGCLogThreshold=<ms>` (`Opt::LongGCLogThreshold`, converted via `MsToNs`).
  * `-XX:AlwaysLogExplicitGcs:<bool>` (`Opt::AlwaysLogExplicitGcs`, default `true`, `always_log_explicit_gcs_`, `heap.h:1430`).
  * Note: `AndroidRuntime.cpp` (`frameworks/base/core/jni/AndroidRuntime.cpp:829, 1042`) passes `-verbose:gc` by default and only overrides `-XX:LongPauseLogThreshold` / `-XX:LongGCLogThreshold` if supplied via `dalvik.vm.extra-opts`.
* **Slow GC Log Trigger (`Heap::LogGC`)** (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:2968-3012`):
  * Checks `CareAboutPauseTimes()` (`heap.cc:231-233`), which returns `Runtime::Current()->InJankPerceptibleProcessState()` (foreground / perceptible app states).
  * Emits `LOG(INFO)` to logcat when:
    1. `kLogAllGCs` is true, OR
    2. `gc_cause == kGcCauseExplicit && always_log_explicit_gcs_`, OR
    3. `CareAboutPauseTimes()` is true AND (`duration > long_gc_log_threshold_` [100 ms] OR `(gc_cause == kGcCauseForAlloc && duration > long_pause_log_threshold_)` [5 ms] OR any stop-the-world pause in `GetCurrentGcIteration()->GetPauseTimes()` is `>= long_pause_log_threshold_` [5 ms]).
  * Logcat format (`heap.cc:3001-3009`):
    `<GcCause> <CollectorName> GC freed <alloc_freed> AllocSpace bytes, <los_objs>(<los_bytes>) LOS objects, <pct>% free, <allocated>/<footprint>, paused <p1,p2,...> total <duration>`
  * If `-verbose:heap` (`VLOG(heap)`) is active, also dumps full `TimingLogger` phase breakdown (`heap.cc:3010`).
* **Additional `long_pause_log_threshold_` (5 ms) Jank Warnings in `Heap`**:
  * `Heap::WaitForGcToCompleteLocked(GcCause, Thread*)` (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:3713-3751`): if `wait_time > long_pause_log_threshold_`, logs `LOG(INFO) << "WaitForGcToComplete blocked " << cause << " on " << last_gc_cause << " for " << PrettyDuration(wait_time)` (`L3738-3741`).
  * `Heap::IncrementDisableThreadFlip(Thread*)` (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:1019-1049`): JNI critical region entry waiting on GC thread flip; logs `LOG(INFO) << "IncrementDisableThreadFlip blocked for " << PrettyDuration(wait_time)` if `wait_time > long_pause_log_threshold_` (`L1045-1047`).
  * `Heap::ThreadFlipBegin(Thread*)` (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:1084-1107`): GC waiting on active JNI critical regions; logs `LOG(INFO) << "ThreadFlipBegin blocked for " << PrettyDuration(wait_time)` if `wait_time > long_pause_log_threshold_` (`L1103-1105`).

### 1.2 GC Pause, Throughput & Rate Histograms and `ArtMetrics`
* **Heap GC Rate Histograms** (`runtime/gc/heap.h:1744-1760`, `runtime/gc/heap.cc:422-429, 1294-1357, 1413-1425, 3020-3079`):
  * Window: `kGcCountRateHistogramWindowDuration = MsToNs(10 * 1000)` (**10 s**), `kGcCountRateMaxBucketCount = 200`, `kGcCountRateHistogramMaxNumMissedWindows = 100`.
  * `gc_count_rate_histogram_` (`"gc count rate histogram"`) & `blocking_gc_count_rate_histogram_` (`"blocking gc count rate histogram"`), updated in `Heap::FinishGC` -> `Heap::UpdateGcCountRateHistograms()` (`heap.cc:3014-3079`).
  * Exposed via `Heap::DumpGcCountRateHistogram` / `DumpBlockingGcCountRateHistogram` (`heap.cc:1413-1425`, backing `Debug.getRuntimeStat("art.gc.gc-count-rate-histogram")` and `"art.gc.blocking-gc-count-rate-histogram"`), `SIGQUIT` ANR traces (`Heap::DumpForSigQuit` -> `DumpGcPerformanceInfo`, `heap.cc:1294-1357, 3753-3766`), and shutdown (`-XX:DumpGCPerformanceOnShutdown`).
* **Per-Collector Histograms** (`runtime/gc/collector/garbage_collector.h:170-200`, `garbage_collector.cc:115-139, 145-195, 497-548`):
  * `pause_histogram_` (`"<name> paused"`, bucket width `500` us, `32` buckets).
  * `rss_histogram_` (`"<name> peak-rss"`, bucket width `10` KB, `16` buckets, sampled via `mincore()` in `ExtractRssFromMincore`, `L145-195` when `-Xgc:measure` is enabled).
  * `freed_bytes_histogram_` (`"<name> freed-bytes"`, bucket width `10` KB, `16` buckets).
  * `ConcurrentCopying::rb_slow_path_time_histogram_` (`runtime/gc/collector/concurrent_copying.h:467-470`, `concurrent_copying.cc:110-111, 3738-3744, 3811-3822`): `"Mutator time in read barrier slow path"` (bucket `500`, `32` buckets) + `rb_slow_path_count_total_` / `rb_slow_path_count_gc_total_`.
* **ART Telemetry (`ArtMetrics` -> statsd / logcat / file)** (`garbage_collector.cc:243-279`, `mark_compact.cc:465-468, 577-580`, `concurrent_copying.cc:146-165`, `libartbase/base/flags.h:266-317`):
  * Records `WorldStopTimeDuringGCAvg`, `GcWorldStopTime[Delta]`, `GcWorldStopCount[Delta]`, `TotalGcCollectionTime[Delta]`, and Young/Full per-collector metrics: `CollectionTime` histogram, `Count[Delta]`, `TracingThroughput[Avg]` (scanned MB/s), `Throughput[Avg]` (freed MB/CPU-s via `Iteration::GetEstimatedThroughput`, `garbage_collector.cc:110-113`), `ScannedBytes[Delta]`, `FreedBytes[Delta]`, `Duration[Delta]`, and `AppSlowPathDurationDelta`.
  * Controlled via `Flags` (`libartbase/base/flags.h:266-317`): `persist.device_config.runtime_native.metrics.*` / `dalvik.vm.metrics.*` (default 2% session sampling to statsd: `MetricsReportingMods=2`, `MetricsReportingNumMods=100`, `MetricsWriteToStatsd=true`).

### 1.3 ATrace / Systrace Markers in GC (`ATRP` / `ATRACE_TAG_DALVIK`)
* **Automatic Phase Tracing via `TimingLogger::ScopedTiming`** (`runtime/base/timing_logger.h:182-198`, `runtime/base/timing_logger.cc:139-148`):
  * Every `TimingLogger::StartTiming(label)` calls `ATraceBegin(label)` (`L142`) and `EndTiming()` calls `ATraceEnd()` (`L147`). Thus **every** GC phase wrapped in `TimingLogger::ScopedTiming` in `MarkCompact` (`mark_compact.cc:672, 790, 1190, 1514-1664, 3362, 3680, 4189, 4234, 4392, ...`, e.g., `(Paused)MarkingPause`, `ReclaimPhase`, `(Paused)KernelPreparation`, `CompactionPhase`) and `ConcurrentCopying` (`concurrent_copying.cc:249, 404, 542-579, 754, 804, 844, 1371, 1444, 2487, 2638, ...`, e.g., `InitializePhase`, `(Paused)FlipCallback`, `FlipThreadRoots`, `MarkingPhase`, `CopyingPhase`, `ReclaimPhase`) automatically appears as a nested ATrace/Perfetto slice.
* **Explicit Collector & Heap Slices and Counters**:
  * `GarbageCollector::Run` (`garbage_collector.cc:47-84, 198, 281-285`): outer `ScopedTrace("<PrettyCause> <CollectorName> GC")` (`L198`) and `TraceGCMetric` counters (`ATraceIntegerValue` with int32 wrap protection): `"freed_normal_object_bytes"`, `"freed_large_object_bytes"`, `"freed_bytes"`.
  * `MarkCompact::RunPhases` -> `TraceFaults()` (`mark_compact.cc:858-870, 881, 888`): reads `getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD)` and emits `ATraceIntegerValue("Minflt-GC", usage.ru_minflt)` and `ATraceIntegerValue("Majflt-GC", usage.ru_majflt)` (major faults = disk/zram decompression during GC).
  * `ConcurrentCopying::MarkFromReadBarrierWithMeasurements` (`concurrent_copying.cc:3797`): `ScopedTrace` on read-barrier slow path when `-Xgc:measure` is active.
  * `Heap::TraceHeapSize(size_t)` (`heap.cc:2745-2747, 3824, 4882`): emits `ATraceIntegerValue("Heap size (KB)", heap_size / KB)` after GC utilization sizing and on TLAB/bulk allocations (`>= 16 KB`).
  * `Heap` blocking/trim/trigger slices (`heap.cc`): `"IncrementDisableThreadFlip"` (`L1035`), `"Deflating monitors"` (`L1624`), `Heap::TrimIndirectReferenceTables` (`L1656`), `Heap::TrimSpaces` (`L1722`), `"GC: Wait For Completion <cause>"` (`L3730`), `"HomogeneousSpaceCompact"` (`L3954`), `"PureTimeGcTrigger"` (`L4327`).

### 1.4 Blocking GC, Native GC Triggering & Time-Based GC
* **Blocking GC Accounting** (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:3022-3028, 3707-3751`):
  * `Heap::WaitForGcToComplete` -> `WaitForGcToCompleteLocked`: sets `running_collection_is_blocking_ = true` whenever a non-`HeapTaskDaemon` thread waits (`!task_processor_->IsRunningThread(self)`), accumulates `total_wait_time_`, and in `Heap::FinishGC` increments `blocking_gc_count_`, `blocking_gc_time_`, and `blocking_gc_count_last_window_`.
* **Native GC Triggering** (`runtime/native_gc_triggering.md:1-109`, `runtime/gc/heap.h:179-190, 1301-1305, 1526-1536, 1663`, `runtime/gc/heap.cc:2757-2795, 4392-4501`):
  * Total tracked native memory: `Heap::GetNativeBytes()` (`heap.cc:2757-2795`) = `mallinfo().uordblks + native_bytes_registered_`.
  * Entry points from `libcore.util.NativeAllocationRegistry`:
    1. `Heap::NotifyNativeAllocations(JNIEnv*)` (`heap.cc:4468-4471`): called once every `kNotifyNativeInterval = 64` (`heap.h:182`) malloc-backed allocations; calls `CheckGCForNative`.
    2. `Heap::RegisterNativeAllocation(JNIEnv*, size_t bytes)` (`heap.cc:4476-4488`): non-malloc native memory; atomically adds `bytes` to `native_bytes_registered_`, increments `native_objects_notified_`, calls `CheckGCForNative` every `64` registrations OR immediately if `bytes > kCheckImmediatelyThreshold` (`10,000,000 / 64 = 156,250` bytes, `heap.h:189`), and reports `ReportAllocationForJavaHeapProf(nullptr, bytes)` (`L4487`).
  * Watermark & Urgency (`Heap::NativeMemoryOverTarget`, `heap.cc:4403-4428`):
    * `NativeAllocationGcWatermark() = target_footprint_ / 8 + max_free_` (`heap.h:1301-1305`).
    * `gc_urgency = (GetBytesAllocated() + new_native_bytes / 2 + old_native_bytes / 65536) / (java_gc_start_bytes + (NativeAllocationGcWatermark() * HeapGrowthMultiplier()) / 2)`.
  * Trigger & Blocking Throttle (`Heap::CheckGCForNative`, `heap.cc:4430-4465`):
    * If `gc_urgency >= 1.0`, triggers concurrent full GC (`kGcCauseForNativeAlloc`, `force_full = true`).
    * If `gc_urgency > kStopForNativeFactor` (`4.0`, `heap.cc:4398`) AND `current_native_bytes > stop_for_native_allocs_` (`-XX:StopForNativeAllocs=_`, default `1 GB` in `runtime_options.def:61`), blocks the allocating thread in a loop up to `kGcWaitIters = 20` iterations (`usleep(2000)` + `WaitForGcToComplete(kGcCauseForNativeAlloc, self)`), logging `LOG(WARNING) << "Slept " << i << " times in native allocation, waiting for GC"` every 10 iterations (`L4454-4456`).
* **Time-Based GC Trigger** (`heap.h:174-177`, `heap-inl.h:467-497`, `heap.cc:4300-4383`):
  * Options: `-XX:EnableTimeBasedGcTrigger=_` (`dalvik.vm.enable_time_based_gc_trigger`), `-XX:HeapMemoryGcCostFactor=_` (`dalvik.vm.heap-memory-gc-cost-factor`). Triggers concurrent GC (`ScopedTrace("PureTimeGcTrigger")`) when `allocated_kb_since_last_gc * ms_since_last_gc >= time_based_gc_threshold_`.

### 1.5 OutOfMemoryError Diagnostics & Heap Listeners
* **Pre-OOME Reclamation Escalation (`Heap::AllocateInternalWithGc`)** (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:1959-2162`):
  * Boosts allocating thread priority via `ScopedPriorityChange::SetToNormalOrBetter()` (`L2039-2040`).
  * Escalates through `next_gc_type_` -> full GC -> clearing SoftReferences (`clear_soft_references = true`) up to `kMaxGcAttempts = 5` (`heap.cc:2025, 2088-2124`), incrementing `pre_oome_gc_count_` (`L2095`).
  * Optionally runs `PerformHomogeneousSpaceCompact()` (`-XX:EnableHSpaceCompactForOOM`, throttled by `-XX:HSpaceCompactForOOMMinIntervalsMs`, default `100,000` ms, `runtime_options.def:85-86`), giving up early if free heap `< 1%` (`kMinFreeHeapAfterGcForAlloc = 0.01`) and newly reclaimed `< 5%` (`kMinFreedHeapAfterGcForAlloc = 0.05`, `heap.cc:186-190`).
* **`Heap::ThrowOutOfMemoryError`** (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:1522-1576`):
  1. Returns pre-allocated OOME if handling native stack overflow (`L1527-1531`; pre-allocated OOMEs initialized at `runtime/runtime.cc:1448-1480`).
  2. Invokes `Runtime::Current()->OutOfMemoryErrorHook()` (`L1533`) -> triggers `perfetto_hprof::DumpPerfettoOutOfMemory`!
  3. Builds diagnostic string (`L1537-1573`): `"Failed to allocate a <byte_count> byte allocation with <total_bytes_free> free bytes and <FreeMemoryUntilOOME> until OOM, target footprint <target_footprint_>, growth limit <growth_limit_>"`, plus per-space fragmentation details (`space->LogFragmentationAllocFailure`) or `"; giving up on allocation because <1% of heap free after GC."` if `total_bytes_free >= byte_count`.
* **`AllocationListener`** (`runtime/gc/allocation_listener.h:40-66`, `heap.h:975-979, 1797`, `heap.cc:1977-1982, 4695-4709`, `heap-inl.h:70-77, 229-234`):
  * Hooks: `HasPreAlloc()`, `PreObjectAllocated(Thread*, MutableHandle<Class>, size_t*)` (can mutate class/size pre-alloc), `ObjectAllocated(Thread*, ObjPtr<Object>*, size_t)`.
  * `SetAllocationListener` / `RemoveAllocationListener` toggle `Instrumentation::InstrumentQuickAllocEntryPoints()` so all allocations take the `kInstrumented = true` slow path (used by JVMTI).
* **`GcPauseListener`** (`runtime/gc/gc_pause_listener.h:25-31`, `heap.h:981-989, 1799`, `heap.cc:4711-4717`, `garbage_collector.cc:427-449`):
  * Hooks: `StartPause()`, `EndPause()`. Fired automatically by `GarbageCollector::ScopedPause` (`garbage_collector.cc:431-447`) and thread-flip root suspension (`ThreadList::FlipThreadRoots` / `SuspendAllForThreadFlip` in `concurrent_copying.cc:765` and `mark_compact.cc:906`).

## 2. Heap Profiling, Leak Monitoring & Reference Processing Jank

### 2.1 Perfetto Java Heap Graph & OOM Heap Dump (`perfetto_hprof`)
* **Files**: `perfetto_hprof/perfetto_hprof.h:1-43`, `perfetto_hprof/perfetto_hprof.cc:1-1394`.
* **Initialization & Eligibility** (`runtime/runtime.cc:1309-1318, 1600`, `AndroidRuntime.cpp:839-840`):
  * Enabled by `-XX:PerfettoHprof=true` (`dalvik.vm.perfetto_hprof`, default `"true"`). Loaded in `Runtime::Start()` (`libperfetto_hprof.so`) if `Dbg::IsJdwpAllowed()` (userdebug/eng), debuggable, profileable, or `system_server`.
* **Signal & Double-Fork Mechanics for Live Heap Dumps (`android.java_hprof`)**:
  * `ArtPlugin_Initialize()` (`perfetto_hprof.cc:1271-1361`) creates `g_signal_pipe_fds`, registers `sigaction` for **`kJavaHeapprofdSignal = __SIGRTMIN + 6`** (`L74, 1290-1306`, capturing `si_value.sival_int` session ID and writing `'x'` to the pipe), and spawns daemon thread `"perfetto_hprof_listener"` (`L1308-1356`).
  * `DumpPerfetto(Thread*)` (`L1171-1200`) -> `ForkAndRun(self, ResumeParentPolicy::IMMEDIATELY, ...)` (`L1059-1119`):
    * Acquires `ScopedGCCriticalSection(self, kGcCauseHprof, kCollectorTypeHprof)` + `ScopedSuspendAll(__FUNCTION__, /*long_suspend=*/true)` and forks under `Locks::thread_list_lock_`.
    * **Minimal App Pause**: Parent immediately releases `ScopedSuspendAll` and `ScopedGCCriticalSection` (`ResumeParentPolicy::IMMEDIATELY`, `L1092-1097`) and waits (`BusyWaitpid`, 1000 ms) for the first child, which immediately calls `daemon(0, 0)` (`L1187`) to double-fork a grandchild and `_exit`.
    * **Grandchild Dump** (`WriteHeapPackets`, `L1121-1169`, `HeapGraphDumper::Dump`, `L651-1019`): arms a **120 s `SIGKILL` watchdog** (`ArmWatchdogOrDie`, `kWatchdogTimeoutSec = 120`, `L75, 111-131`), connects Perfetto data source `"android.java_hprof"`, optionally dumps `/proc/self/smaps` (`DumpSmaps`, `L547-567`), walks GC roots and objects (`VisitObjectsPaused`), splits `HeapGraph` protobuf packets at **`kPacketSizeThreshold = 400,000` bytes** (`L80`, fitting DropBox's 500 KB limit), captures `libcore.util.NativeAllocationRegistry.size` (`L976-982`) and space location (`HEAP_TYPE_APP`, `HEAP_TYPE_ZYGOTE`, `HEAP_TYPE_BOOT_IMAGE`), flushes, and calls `FastExit(0)`.
* **OutOfMemoryError Heap Dump (`android.java_hprof.oom`)** (`perfetto_hprof.cc:1202-1268, 1358`):
  * Registered via `Runtime::SetOutOfMemoryErrorHook(perfetto_hprof::DumpPerfettoOutOfMemory)` (`L1358`).
  * Fast bailout: reads sysprop **`traced.oome_heap_session.count`** (`L1210-1214`); returns immediately if `0`. Enforces single execution per process via `g_oome_triggered` (`L1218-1223`).
  * Uses **`ResumeParentPolicy::DEFERRED`** (`L1228-1246`): parent stays suspended in `BusyWaitpid(child, 120000)` (up to **120 s**) until the child finishes dumping, preventing the crashing app from dying early and causing `lmkd`/system_server to `SIGKILL` the process cgroup mid-dump.
  * Child (`"perfetto_oome_hprof"`, no `daemon()`) registers data source **`"android.java_hprof.oom"`** (`L1252`), activates Perfetto trigger **`"com.android.telemetry.art-outofmemory"`** (`timeout_ms = 1000`, `L1253`), waits up to `1000 ms` (`TimedWaitForDataSource`, `L1258`) for a matching session (`IsOomeHeapDumpAllowed`, `L173-184` + `process_cmdline` `fnmatch`, `L285-299`), writes `HeapGraph` packets, and exits.

### 2.2 Perfetto `heapprofd` Java Allocation Sampling (`HeapSampler`)
* **Files**: `runtime/javaheapprof/javaheapsampler.h:1-98`, `runtime/javaheapprof/javaheapsampler.cc:1-85`, `runtime/gc/heap.cc:120-141, 809-812, 4614-4635, 4734-4823`.
* **Configuration**: `-XX:PerfettoJavaHeapStackProf=true` (`dalvik.vm.perfetto_javaheap`, default `"true"` in `AndroidRuntime.cpp:843-844`).
* **Registration**: `Heap::InitPerfettoJavaHeapProf()` (`heap.cc:4614-4635`) registers **`"com.android.art"`** via `AHeapInfo_create("com.android.art")` + `AHeapProfile_registerHeap`, wiring `EnableHeapSamplerCallback` / `DisableHeapSamplerCallback`.
* **TLAB-Shrinking Sampling Algorithm**:
  * Default `p_sampling_interval_` = **`4096` bytes** (`4 KB`, `javaheapsampler.h:86`), dynamically updated from `AHeapProfileEnableCallbackInfo_getSamplingInterval`.
  * Because TLAB fast-path allocations bypass C++, `HeapSampler::NextRandomTlabSize` (`javaheapsampler.cc:28-47`) caps TLAB refill target to `min(target, sampling_interval / 8)` and samples from `std::exponential_distribution<double>(1.0 / target)` under `rng_lock_`.
  * On TLAB refill (`Heap::AllocWithNewTLAB`, `heap.cc:4820-4823` -> `ReportTlabAllocation`, `javaheapsampler.cc:57-72`), computes `adjusted_size = allocation_size + tlab_unsampled_bytes_ - pre_tlab_size`, saves `post_tlab_size` into `thread_local size_t tlab_unsampled_bytes_`, and calls `AHeapProfile_reportAllocation(perfetto_heap_id_, obj_id, adjusted_size)`.
  * Direct non-TLAB reporting (`Heap::ReportAllocationForJavaHeapProf`, `heap-inl.h:505-509`): called on `AllocNonMovableObject` (`heap.h:290`), `AllocLargeObject` (`heap-inl.h:286`), Region non-TLAB fallback (`heap.cc:4781, 4792, 4805`), and `RegisterNativeAllocation(nullptr, bytes)` (`heap.cc:4487`). (Allocations only; frees are not reported to `heapprofd`.)

### 2.3 Legacy Allocation Tracker & Standard HPROF Dumper
* **`AllocRecordObjectMap`** (`runtime/gc/allocation_record.h:202-306`, `runtime/gc/allocation_record.cc:34-272`):
  * Backing store for DDMS / `VMDebug.startAllocCounting` / legacy allocation tracking.
  * Defaults: `kDefaultNumAllocRecords = 512 * 1024` (`524,288`), `kDefaultNumRecentRecords = 64 * 1024 - 1` (`65,535`), `kDefaultAllocStackDepth = 16` (configurable up to `kMaxSupportedStackDepth = 128`, `scratch.trace_depth` sysprop or DDMS).
  * `SetAllocTrackingEnabled` (`allocation_record.cc:157-200`) instruments quick alloc entry points (`heap-inl.h:223-228`). `RecordAllocation` (`L202-264`) walks frames (`StackVisitor::WalkStack` with `kIncludeInlinedFrames`) outside `alloc_tracker_lock_` and appends `(GcRoot<Object>, AllocRecord)`. Swept during GC via `SweepAllocationRecords` (`L109-140`).
* **Standard `hprof::DumpHeap`** (`runtime/hprof/hprof.h:27`, `runtime/hprof/hprof.cc:430-911, 1616-1627`):
  * Implements `Debug.dumpHprofData` (`JAVA PROFILE 1.0.3` binary format) to file (`DumpToFile`, `L754-803`) or DDMS `HPDS` chunk (`DumpToDdmsDirect`, `L805-826`).
  * Unlike `perfetto_hprof`, runs **synchronously in-process** under `ScopedGCCriticalSection` + `ScopedSuspendAll(..., /*long_suspend=*/true)` (`L1619-1622`) across two full heap passes. If `IsAllocTrackingEnabled()`, `PopulateAllocationTrackingTraces()` (`L828-866`) embeds `HPROF_TAG_STACK_TRACE` serials into every dumped object record.

### 2.4 Reference Processing Contention & Jank Monitoring
* **Files**: `runtime/gc/reference_processor.h:1-134`, `runtime/gc/reference_processor.cc:1-452`, `runtime/reference_processing_jank.md:1-84`.
* **Mutator Blocking & Jank Detection (`ReferenceProcessor::GetReferent`)** (`reference_processor.cc:92-166`):
  * Concurrent `RpState` progresses `kStarting` -> `kInitMarkingDone` -> `kInitClearingDone` (`reference_processor.h:111`, `reference_processor.cc:197, 222, 243`). Once `kInitMarkingDone` is reached, normal `SoftReference`/`WeakReference.get()` returns non-blocking by checking `collector_->IsMarked(referent)` (`L149-160`).
  * Must block on `condition_.WaitHoldingLocks(self)` under `Locks::reference_processor_lock_` when `rp_state_ == kStarting`, or `reference->IsFinalizerReferenceInstance()`, or (under non-Baker RB) `PhantomReference` (`L124-139`).
  * **Observability**:
    * Emits ATrace slice **`"GetReferent blocked"`** (`ATraceBegin` at `L133`, `ATraceEnd` at `L111`).
    * Logs jank warning if total wait exceeds **`kReportMillis = 10` ms** (`L113-116`):
      `LOG(WARNING) << "Weak pointer dereference blocked for " << millis << " milliseconds."`
  * Collector-side slices: `"Marking for <N> SoftReferences"` (`L180-181`) and `"Marking from <enqueued> / <total> finalizers"` (`L261-263`).
* **Architectural Root Cause (`runtime/reference_processing_jank.md:1-84`)**:
  * Documents why `FinalizerReference` processing causes mutator jank: finalizer-reachable objects require a 2nd marking pass to resurrect unmarked referents, during which native weak references (`JNI WeakGlobalRef`, `InternTable` strings — governed by `Thread::GetWeakRefAccessEnabled()`) must block mutators completely because returning `nullptr` (if later resurrected) or returning an un-forwarded/un-traced pointer is unsafe.

## 3. Lock Contention, Monitor Timeout & Thread Priority Monitoring

### 3.1 Thin-Lock Spinning & Inflation (`Monitor`)
* **Files**: `runtime/monitor.h:63`, `runtime/monitor.cc:63, 1059-1197`, `runtime/runtime_options.def:151`.

* **Files**: `runtime/gc/reference_processor.h:1-134`, `runtime/gc/reference_processor.cc:1-452`, `runtime/reference_processing_jank.md:1-84`.

Once `kInitMarkingDone` is reached, normal `SoftReference`/`WeakReference.get()` returns non-blocking by checking `collector_->IsMarked(referent)` (`L149-160`).
  * Must block on `condition_.WaitHoldingLocks(self)` under `Locks::reference_processor_lock_` when `rp_state_ == kStarting`, or `reference->IsFinalizerReferenceInstance()`, or (under non-Baker RB) `PhantomReference` (`L124-139`).

    * Emits ATrace slice **`"GetReferent blocked"`** (`ATraceBegin` at `L133`, `ATraceEnd` at `L111`).
    * Logs jank warning if total wait exceeds **`kReportMillis = 10` ms** (`L113-116`):

* **Architectural Root Cause (`runtime/reference_processing_jank.md:1-84`)**:
  * Documents why `FinalizerReference` processing causes mutator jank: finalizer-reachable objects require a 2nd marking pass to resurrect unmarked referents, during which native weak references (`JNI WeakGlobalRef`, `InternTable` strings — governed by `Thread::GetWeakRefAccessEnabled()`) must block mutators completely because returning `nullptr` (if later resurrected) or returning an un-forwarded/un-traced pointer is unsafe.

### 3.2 Fat-Lock Contention Sampling, Thresholds & Owner Tracking
* **Configuration & Thresholds** (`runtime/monitor.cc:53-54, 84-95`, `runtime/parsed_options.cc:348-353`, `runtime/runtime_options.def:125-126`, `AndroidRuntime.cpp:267, 991-993`):
  * `-Xlockprofthreshold:<ms>` (`Opt::LockProfThreshold`, default `0` in ART; mapped from sysprop **`dalvik.vm.lockprof.threshold`** in `AndroidRuntime.cpp:991-993`, commonly set to `500` ms on Android builds) -> `lock_profiling_threshold_`.
  * `-Xstackdumplockprofthreshold:<ms>` (`Opt::StackDumpLockProfThreshold`, default `0`; settable via `dalvik.vm.extra-opts`) -> `stack_dump_lock_profiling_threshold_`.
  * `kLongWaitMs = 100 * kDebugThresholdFudgeFactor` (**100 ms** in release builds, `1000 ms` in debug builds, `monitor.cc:53-54`). Both thresholds above are also multiplied by `kDebugThresholdFudgeFactor`.
* **Owner Method & Dex PC Tracking** (`runtime/monitor.h:360-429`, `runtime/monitor-inl.h:33-81`, `runtime/monitor.cc:172-225, 507-508, 751, 854`):
  * Uses lock-free XOR-checksummed fields (`lock_owner_`, `lock_owner_method_`, `lock_owner_dex_pc_`, `lock_owner_sum_`).
  * **Eager** when `ATraceEnabled()`: owner records acquisition frame (`SetLockingMethod` / `SetLockingMethodNoProxy`) on `Install`/`TryLock`/`Lock`.
  * **Lazy** when only `lock_profiling_threshold_ != 0`: contender writes `orig_owner` into `lock_owner_request_` before blocking (`monitor.cc:507-508`); owner records its release/wait site in `Unlock`/`Wait` via `CheckLockOwnerRequest` (`monitor-inl.h:33-41`).
* **Proportional Sampling & Reporting Channels** (`Monitor::Lock`, `monitor.cc:458-636`, `Monitor::LogContentionEvent`, `runtime/monitor_android.cc:35-120`):
  * Contender transitions to `ThreadState::kBlocked` (`L517`) and blocks on `monitor_lock_.ExclusiveLock(self)` (`L520`).
  * **Sampling formula** (`monitor.cc:529-535`):
    * `wait_ms >= lock_profiling_threshold_` -> `sample_percent = 100`.
    * `wait_ms < lock_profiling_threshold_` -> `sample_percent = 100 * wait_ms / lock_profiling_threshold_`.
    * Triggered when `sample_percent != 0 && (rand() % 100) < sample_percent`.
  * **Reporting Channel 1 — Logcat `LOG(WARNING)`** (`monitor.cc:541-614`):
    * If `stack_dump_lock_profiling_threshold_ > 0 && wait_ms > stack_dump_lock_profiling_threshold_`: runs synchronous checkpoint `orig_owner->RequestSynchronousCheckpoint(&owner_trace)` + `self->DumpJavaStack` and logs `"Long monitor contention with owner <name> (<tid>) at <owner_method>(<file>:<line>) waiters=<N> in <contender_method> for <duration>\nCurrent owner stack:\n...\nContender stack:\n..."`.
    * Else if `wait_ms > kLongWaitMs` (**100 ms**) and `owners_method != nullptr`: logs the single-line `"Long monitor contention with owner ..."` warning.
  * **Reporting Channel 2 — Binary EventLog `dvm_lock_sample` (Tag `20003`)** (`runtime/monitor_android.cc:50-109`):
    * Writes 11 fields to `LOG_ID_EVENTS`: `[process_name (<=32 chars from /proc/self/cmdline), is_sensitive_thread (1/0 via Thread::IsSensitiveThread() -> AndroidRuntime runtime_isSensitiveThread), thread_name, wait_ms, contender_file, contender_line, contender_method, owner_file ("-" if identical to contender_file), owner_line, owner_method, sample_percent]`.
  * **Reporting Channel 3 — `PaletteReportLockContention`** (`runtime/monitor_android.cc:110-119`):
    * Invokes `PaletteReportLockContention(env, wait_ms, filename, line_number, method_name, owner_filename, owner_line_number, owner_method_name, proc_name, thread_name)` via `libartpalette` (`art/libartpalette/apex/palette.cc:225-242`).
  * **Reporting Channel 4 — ATrace / Systrace Lock Slices**:
    1. **Java Monitor Contention** (`monitor.cc:469-496, 634-636`, whenever `ATraceEnabled()`): `"monitor contention with owner <name> (<tid>) at <owner_method>(<file>:<line>) waiters=<N> blocking from <contender_method>(<file>:<line>)"`.
    2. **Verbose Monitor Lock/Wait** (`monitor.cc:334-400`, requires BOTH `-verbose:systrace-locks` and `ATraceEnabled()`): `"Locking <addr> at <file>:<line>"` and `"Waiting on <addr> at <file>:<line>"`.

### 3.3 In-Flight Monitor Timeout Stack Dumper (`MonitorTimeoutEnable` / `PerfMonitor`)
* **Files**: `runtime/monitor.h:65-69, 431`, `runtime/monitor.cc:121-125, 154-158, 1774-1781`, `runtime/base/mutex.h:231-241`, `runtime/base/mutex.cc:42-60, 481-590`, `runtime/runtime.cc:1716-1727`, `runtime/runtime_options.def:76-77`, `runtime/parsed_options.cc:415-421`.
* **Purpose**: Standard `Monitor::Lock` contention logging only fires *after* the lock is finally acquired (missing deadlocks or multi-second stalls until release). `MonitorTimeoutEnable` uses timed `futex(FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE)` calls to dump the owner's stack **while the contender is still blocked**.
* **Configuration & Activation**:
  * Options: `-XX:MonitorTimeoutEnable=<bool>` (default `false`), `-XX:MonitorTimeout=<ms>` (default **`500` ms**, clamped to **`[200, 999]` ms** in `runtime.cc:1718-1725`).
  * `Monitor::MaybeEnableTimeout()` (`monitor.cc:1774-1781`): enables `monitor_lock_.setEnableMonitorTimeout()` if the process package is **`"android"`** (`system_server`) OR sysprop **`debug.art.monitor.app`** is `true`.
* **Mechanics (`Mutex::ExclusiveLock` & `Mutex::DumpStack`)** (`runtime/base/mutex.cc:481-575`):
  * On `ETIMEDOUT`, increments `try_times` and (for `try_times <= kMonitorTimeoutTryMax` [**5**]) calls `Mutex::DumpStack(self, wait_start_ms, try_times)`.
  * Per-owner rate limit (`Mutex::IsDumpFrequent`, `L513-532`): stores `"LastDumpStackTime"` in owner's custom TLS; suppresses dump if elapsed `< kIntervalMillis * try_times` (`50 ms * try_times`).
  * Runs synchronous checkpoint on owner (`DumpJavaStack`) and logs:
    `LOG(WARNING) << "Monitor contention with tid " << owner_tid << ", wait time: " << wait_ms << "ms, monitor id: " << monitor_id_ << "\nPerfMonitor owner thread(" << owner_tid << ") stack is:\n" << owner_stack_dump`.
  * *(Implementation quirk at `runtime/base/mutex.cc:489`)*: fallback when `Runtime::Current() == nullptr` assigns `Monitor::kDefaultMonitorTimeoutMs` (`500` ns instead of `MsToNs(500)`) to `timeout_ts.tv_nsec`, though `Runtime::Current()` is always non-null for active Java monitors.

### 3.4 Thread Priority & Priority Inversion Mitigation
* **`ScopedPriorityChange`** (`runtime/scoped_thread_priority_change.h:45-78`, `runtime/scoped_thread_priority_change.cc:27-79`):
  * Gated by trunk-stable flag `com::android::libcore::niceness_apis()`.
  * `SetToNormalOrBetter()` checks `self_->GetCachedNiceness() > 0` (background/low priority) and `getpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, 0) == cached_niceness`, then calls `setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, 0, 0)` (boosting niceness to `0`) until `ResetInternal()` restores `cached_niceness`.
  * **Callsites preventing GC/alloc priority inversion**:
    1. `Heap::AllocateInternalWithGc` (`runtime/gc/heap.cc:2039-2040`): boosts background threads performing blocking GC-for-alloc.
    2. `MarkCompact::RunPhases` (`runtime/gc/collector/mark_compact.cc:878, 885, 892, 898, 910`): boosts GC thread while weak-reference access is disabled (from end of `MarkingPhase` until `ReclaimPhase` re-enables weak refs) and across compaction thread-flip.
    3. `ConcurrentCopying::RunPhases` & `MarkingPhase` (`runtime/gc/collector/concurrent_copying.cc:230, 1630`): boosts GC thread during critical root-flip and reference-processing windows.
* **Design Constraints (`runtime/thread_priorities.md:1-221`)**:
  * Documents Android's 3 priority layers (Java `1..10`, Linux niceness `-20..19` mapped via `PaletteMapPriority`, and `SCHED_FIFO` RT `1..99`), warns that `SCHED_FIFO` threads break ART thin-lock spin/yield loops if holding locks contended by higher-RT threads (`L129-145`), and explains why `FUTEX_LOCK_PI` priority inheritance is not yet enabled on ART monitors/mutexes (`SCHED_OTHER` PI requires Linux `>= 6.12` and incompatible futex word layouts, `L192-221`).
